notes.title: Update 0.8
notes.content:
Excidio 0.8 Change Log
Arcade Mode Revamp!
Arcade mode has been completely revamped! It is now much more inspired by Vampire Survivors. It has new effects, balance changes, changes to army AI, and buildings will now rebuild themselves to keep the carnage going!
Map Improvements
All 3 maps have been completely remade! A complete overhaul, featuring new props, skybox, and textures.
Added skins for both Golem and Raijin!
Both Golem and Raijin now have a skin each, these skins can be applied to enemy AI as well.
Combat and Control improvements!
Changed Raijin's Ultimate Attack. Added a health bar to enemies, the hurt animation can now be triggered more often, for better feedback. Hold to sprint has been replaced with a Toggle sprint.
Visual improvements
Atmosphere effects can be triggered after destroying a certain amount of buildings. As well as lighting improvements, and some improved assets.
Stability Improvements
Added 30fps and 120fps options. Made many improvements for performance. Including better building models, reducing the amount of people, reducing explosion/smoke effects. Resulting in better performance and more gameplay clarity.

notes.title: Development Update
notes.content: We apologize for the slowing down of development, over the course of the last few months, I have been struck with many unfortunate events that have taken my time and energy. A family member passed away due to cancer, and my home is having major foundation issues. The latter is still taking my attention as I am trying to fix it before the winter, so development will still be slow for a while. Thank you all for sticking with us and being patient!

notes.title: Excidio The Kaiju Game Pre-Multi Update
notes.content:
Hello every one! Hope you are doing good
Intro

This is latest update for Excidio The Kaiju game. Purpose of this update is to test new mechanics and gameplay elements before launch of multiplayer. The reason it took so long for the update is I basically remade whole game with better code and to make it work in multiplayer. 

New things in this update:

- New Energy/Stamina system 
- New AI
- New Visual effects
- New Overcharge ability for Excidio
- New interaction between objects 
- Destruction and optimization changes
- New camera position 
- New slow motion camera that you can change time speed with for cooler shots
- Dynamic fog that builds up as things are destroyed
- New throwable items

After I hear feedback on Energy/Stamina system I will improve it further with changes to damage,movement speed and things like that. Also If how fog works now is not liked I can remove it and put it back as it was before.

Things that are but not included
This are things I have made but are not included in this update as they need little more polish and work done

Multiplayer
Human char mode
New AI ability 
Small enemy AI

notes.title: Naval Update Incoming!
notes.content:
Naval Update incoming!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40510941/290dd7c305d30bcd94bda57ef567ae90de430b85.png
Hello everyone I would like to share with you some new things for new update! 

Ships 

First thing that is coming are ships! Ships will sail trough water and you will be able to sink them. Plan is to have few ship models including cargo ships, smaller civilan ships and military ships. 

Two new graphic options

With new update there will be also added two new graphical options 

One  will be Advanced Destruction and Another will be Debris particles. First one will enable advanced destruction where structural integrity will be better and also will make it so destruction interacts with the world. One building falling on another will destroy that one and so on. 

Debris particles will make it so that debris from the destroyed buildings will create particle effects when they hit ground or water. Both of these make impact on fps but give a lot to a look and feel. It is optimal and if it proves that most users can't use it I will remove it. I optimized it as much as I could

There were some changes to lighting and night mode. Game models will have more depth now.
